latest.title: A new layout: problems first, and a sidebar with five places to fix them
latest.summary: The board is rebuilt around what needs your attention. The Overview opens on Needs attention, each finding with a button that takes you to the exact setting, and a way back to where you were. A sidebar on the left holds five places, the open one with its views under it: the Overview, Businesses (results, cash and loans, prices against the market, a standards comparison with uniforms you can set from it, milestones), Supply (the changes to make, imports, deliveries, production, and a goods flow you can drag and zoom like the map), Staffing (schedules, staff needs, payroll) and Expansion (demand, finding a location, planning a factory), then the City map and the Wiki. The button at its foot folds the sidebar to a strip of icons, and the board remembers it. Every business page links to its schedule, deliveries and prices. Changes you mark, apply through the game link, or that a later save confirms now look different, and preferences and help sit under the one ··· menu at the sidebar's foot. Old links keep working.
